name: ALMANACS
description: ALMANACS is a language model explainability benchmark that measures the efficacy of explainability methods by scoring their simulatability—how well explanations improve behavior prediction on new inputs. It covers twelve safety-relevant topics with train-test distributional shifts and uses another language model to automate evaluation.
reputation: A niche but well-regarded benchmark in LM explainability research, especially for evaluating simulatability under distribution shift.
notes: Automated benchmark using LLMs to predict behavior based on explanations; highlights challenges in developing effective explainability methods.
